messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Last-leg commit docket: final sweep and stage confirmations

Team —

We have a hard close window for Acme Analytics and I want a tight sweep so finance can lock forecast by EOD Friday. Quick asks:

1) Please confirm committed amount and source (PO / verbal / emailed sign-off)
2) Confirm current stage in SFDC and any gating blockers
3) If you’re holding for legal/PO, add expected eta (date/time)

I’m attaching an editable commit_rollup_v3.xlsx — update your row by 3pm PT today. Key fields for the rollup: committed_amount, contract_sent_date, expected_po_date, billing_profile, and final_owner.

Sprint checklist (48h play):
- Marissa: confirm final pricing and any discount approvals (if >10%)
- Ben: validate technical readiness and deployment start date
- Priyom: flag any procurement notes that would delay PO by >48h
- Laura: confirm AE ownership and renewal contact on the account

Keep replies short — one-line confirmations are fine. I’ll do a quick rollup at 3:30pm and call out anything that needs escalation.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Last-leg commit docket: final sweep and stage confirmations

Vivek —

Confirmed from my side:
- Committed amount: $185,000; source: signed SOW + emailed sign-off (see attached PO stub)
- SFDC stage: Contract -> Using the "Verbal + Signed SOW" flag
- Legal: minor redline accepted last night; no further changes expected
- Expected PO date: 2027-05-05 (they said "early next week" but attached stub shows intent)

I updated my row in commit_rollup_v3.xlsx (column: final_owner = marissa_cole). No discount beyond the approved 7% — finance already signed off.

If we need to accelerate billing, let me know and I can ask Acme for a pro-forma invoice.

Marissa

Quick update — technical validation complete, deployment start can be week of 2027-05-17. Notes:
- Integration touchpoints: VPC peering needs networking ticket; I logged NET-4786 and asked customer to confirm IP ranges
- SSO: Acme will use Okta; they confirmed metadata exchange next Tue
- Risk: if PO delays push beyond 05/10, we may need to shift onboarding to the following sprint (impact to first invoice date)

Marked these in the spreadsheet (technical_notes column). No blockers that would prevent closing, just coordination items.

Ben

Thanks for the clear checklist. Confirming:

- Attached is the PO stub we circulated internally (acme_po_stub.pdf). We will push the official PO to procurement@redwood.ai once approved.
- Deployment window looks good; Ben — I’ll loop in our infra lead (CC’d on separate thread) for the networking details.

If anything changes on our side, I’ll update this thread immediately.

Best,
Jordan Lee
